377:t_1:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, it's what you'd call a final notice, you see. With failures piling up like this, the boss can hardly stay silent.」

377:t_1:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I've racked up my share of military merit, too! $$バルビエル$$ knows that full well!」

377:t_1:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Which is why I'm not saying you'll be executed.」

377:t_1:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then defeat $c. By any means necessary.」

377:t_1:10.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I pray for your success. Personally, I'd be a little lonely if I lost my conversation partner.」

377:t_1:15.en:
???
「Security of this caliber means nothing to me.」

377:t_1:17.en:
???
「Heh... First, let me apologize for entering this room without permission.」

377:t_1:18.en:
???
「But I will be your herald of victory.」

377:t_1:20.en:
???
「Your enemy... $c... I will bury them for you.」

377:t_1:26.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「You seem to be bothered by that army of unmanned machines.」

377:t_1:28.en:
$$葵$$
「It's irritating when a bunch of unidentified things run wild like that.」

377:t_1:29.en:
$$くらら$$
「According to $$セイミー$$, an autonomous AI is seizing control of those machines.」

377:t_1:30.en:
$$朔哉$$
「So they hijack mechs from all sorts of organizations and turn them into fighting strength, huh?」

377:t_1:31.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「But it seems we're the only ones actually being attacked.」

377:t_1:32.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「So $c is what they're after.」

377:t_1:33.en:
$$葵$$
「In short, whoever holds a grudge against us is the mastermind.」

377:t_1:34.en:
$$朔哉$$
「There are so many of them, I couldn't even guess.」

377:t_1:35.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「At the very least, they're certainly villains.」

377:t_1:36.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Well, $c isn't exactly a hero of justice, as they say.」

377:t_1:38.en:
$$葵$$
「If something's worrying you, tell us, $$タケル$$.」

377:t_1:39.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「$$葵$$'s right. Bottling it up alone will only make the worry grow.」

377:t_1:40.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Yeah, yeah. We've come this far, so we're all in the same boat. Whatever's bothering you, we'll take it on.」

377:t_1:42.en:
$$朔哉$$
「W-what!? Fine, I don't have any partner to be with in sickness and in health anyway!」

377:t_1:43.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Unlike me, $$タケル$$'s got $$ロゼ$$! I bet when we're not around, you get all spoiled and cling to her and spill everything that's in your heart!」

377:t_1:44.en:
$$朔哉$$
「I bet $$ロゼ$$ gently wraps you up, pets your head, gives you a lap pillow, and all that!」

377:t_1:45.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「W-we don't do any of that!」

377:t_1:46.en:
$$タケル$$
「But $$ロゼ$$ is always helping me.」

377:t_1:48.en:
$$朔哉$$
「See? ...This is how it always ends!」

377:t_1:49.en:
$$葵$$
「That was just $$朔哉$$ shooting himself in the foot, wasn't it?」

377:t_1:50.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「$$朔哉$$... I laughed because I thought we've all changed quite a bit.」

377:t_1:51.en:
$$くらら$$
「You're right. Listening to someone's worries and lending them a hand... we couldn't have imagined that until a little while ago.」

377:t_1:52.en:
$$葵$$
「But that's how we got stronger. ...Right, $$タケル$$?」

377:t_1:54.en:
$$タケル$$
「Then I'll follow $$チームＤ$$'s example and lean on all of you.」

377:t_1:55.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Are you still worried about the existence of that mysterious robot army?」

377:t_1:56.en:
$$タケル$$
「Yeah... Through them, I sense strong malice.」

377:t_1:57.en:
$$タケル$$
「But it's different from ordinary malice or hostility... A purer will... If I had to put it into words, something close to a sense of mission. That's what I feel.」

377:t_1:59.en:
$$くらら$$
「...Like a soldier who's been ordered to carry out a massacre?」

377:t_1:60.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$くらら$$'s analogy is spot on. It's not that the one carrying it out is evil; the act itself is filled with malice. That's the feeling.」

377:t_1:61.en:
$$朔哉$$
「I'll ask you straight out. ...Is it Xul we're up against?」

377:t_1:65.en:
$$タケル$$
「The unease I feel isn't only about that robot army... I feel like some colder, darker gloom is closing in around us...」

377:t_1:67.en:
$$タケル$$
「Sorry. It's only a vague image even to me, and this is about all I can tell you.」

377:t_1:68.en:
$$朔哉$$
「That's enough, $$タケル$$. Like we promised, we'll share your worry too.」

377:t_1:69.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「That unease... Even if we don't know what it is, let's stay on guard.」

377:t_1:70.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「We have to be on guard about more than just that.」

377:t_1:71.en:
$$タケル$$
「What do you mean, $$エイーダ$$?」

377:t_1:72.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Danger is closing in on us. Look...」

377:t_1:73.en:
$$谷川$$
「$$ティティ$$! What did you put in the curry!?」

377:t_1:74.en:
$$ティティ$$
「A secret ingredient. I heard instant coffee makes it taste good.」

377:t_1:75.en:
$$中原$$
「Even so, putting in a whole jar...」

377:t_1:76.en:
$$谷川$$
「Now it's not hidden at all!」

377:t_1:77.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So old-fashioned... These days, a wallflower doesn't suit anyone... You've got to value self-promotion.」

377:t_1:78.en:
$$中原$$
「Hold on...! Look closely, this isn't coffee, it's cocoa!」

377:t_1:79.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Well, cocoa is sweeter and tastier.」

377:t_1:80.en:
$$谷川$$
「The soul of curry is spice! If you want sweet, just drink the cocoa straight!」

377:t_1:81.en:
$$ティティ$$
「No way, no way. I can't drink a whole jar.」

377:t_1:83.en:
$$大山$$
「With $$エイミー$$ gone, I thought I'd have the Living Team pull their weight, but the road ahead looks rough.」

377:t_1:84.en:
$$入江$$
「Even if we wanted to send her back to Japan, $c is already in the Central Continent.」

377:t_1:85.en:
$$谷川$$
「$n! Take responsibility and do something about it!」
